title: Tinh vân
about: Round x16 (album 11), the user: "hãy sáng tác album 11", after album 10 (electronic sleep) was kept whole: more electronic sleep ambient (style ngu-dt), slow (46 bpm), drone, pad, air, sub, swells, choir, an improvised keys tune with a long echo. No drums. An original piece.
